about: One table of the interface surfaces a UI command can name (owner 2026-11-01): each family lists its ids in schema order. aliasOf = an old id still accepted (commands, saved conversations, voice, older clients) and treated as the new one; stateOnly = only an older client still reports it, commands reject it; label = how a reply names it; words / say = the spoken words (regular expression) and the spoken name when it differs from label; guest = a visitor may open it; dialogs: closeOnly = only a user action may open it; disclosures: card = one per object (`id`, else the most recent), sparse = only open ids are reported, idRequired = the hint when a command lacks its `id`, uncapped = every instance is reported. Read by ui_control.py, guest.py, voice_intents.py and the client (uiSurfaces.ts); add a surface here and nowhere else.

positions-drawer.desc: 1.6.6: the 持仓抽屉 became the 持仓 side panel; the name stays as its alias (judged by panel positions; a 1.6.5 client still reports the drawer).

quick-order-confirm.desc: Close only: dialogs that only a user action may open carry a trading intent.

strategy-designer.desc: The retired 策略设计窗 (2026-10-08): opens / closes the 策略编辑卡 on the selected strategy and is judged by that card.

proposal-confirm.desc: The AI trade/risk-rule confirmation dialog of the 1.8.0 desktop client only (the web client submits from the card itself since 2026-10-19); closing it cancels the candidate. Drop it with the next desktop version.

strategy-launch.desc: 策略详情 · 上线运行 (2026-09-25): the launch dialog (contract, 执行方式, 验证并上线) of the selected strategy; its fields are the `strategyLaunch` command, 验证并上线 stays a user click.

change-password.desc: 设置 → 账户 → 修改密码 (2026-10-21): open / close only (先 settingsPage: account); the inputs never reach the snapshot and no command fills them — changing the password stays the person's own action.

protection-reprice-confirm.desc: 图上拖线改价 (2026-10-24): the chart's confirm card for a dragged stop / take; close only (closing keeps the old level).

designer-expanded.desc: designer-expanded (the retired 策略设计窗's 展开) stays accepted; the client rejects it.

card-details.desc: Every conversation card's folded 详情 (identifiers, provenance, explanations).

voice-call.desc: Real-time voice: the floating orb's call (open = in a call), its mute, and its long-press menu.

voice-review.desc: 复盘页“语音复盘” (2026-09-29): open = the call is (or opens) walking through the day's notable trades.

unlinked-notes.desc: 复盘页末尾“未关联的补充（N）” (2026-10-04): open = the list of 补充 whose fill a real report replaced is shown; only while there are any (`review.unlinkedNotes` carries the count).

review-how.desc: 今日复盘 (2026-10-06): the block's 怎么算的 fold (the tag rule in the owner's words).

habits-how.desc: 习惯对照 (2026-10-25): the block's 怎么算的 fold (how 只做计划内 and the two holding estimates are computed).

chat-history.desc: The AI dock's 历史对话 list (open = the list is shown; `chatHistory` in the state carries it).

ai-command-result.desc: AI 指令栏 (改版第二步 2026-11-01): the result of the last line sent from the header bar, a bubble beside the AI 球 (no longer a drop-down under the bar) — what the AI did in one line with one 撤销 for what can be undone, or a waiting order card, or the answer's first words; fades after about 8 s (20 s with a card or an undo); available once a line was sent from the bar in this window. On the phone (方案 B 2026-11-01) the same result opens from the 回执条 above the bottom bar (closed = the one-line 回执条), for lines sent from the 按住说话 key or its typing.

activity-clear.desc: AI 动态卡 “清空显示”: open = hide the finished records (state true = nothing left to clear).

strategy-guide.desc: 策略面板: a 运行中 card's 运行日志 (per strategy, `id` = its id). strategy-new opens the 策略编辑卡 on a new strategy (open) or closes it (= strategyEditor {new} / {close}). strategy-guide (the AI 引导 设计卡) was retired 2026-10-08 with the guided design: the value stays accepted for older agents, the client rejects it.

strategy-ask-ai.desc: 策略页改版第八批 (2026-10-08): the 结果页's 跟 AI 说怎么改 input (open = the input is shown; sending is chat:send with the strategy as focus).

strategy-editor-trades.desc: 策略编辑卡 (2026-10-08): its folds — the trades the AI prefill is based on (查看这 N 笔), ③ 怎么平仓's 更多 (保本、分批止盈、按时间止盈、最长持仓、按条件平仓), the read-only 高级规则 a card cannot edit, and the 回测明细 under the result bar. Each needs the card open (strategyEditor {open}).

strategy-editor-section.desc: 手机编辑卡 (2026-10-08): the phone page's four sections and its 策略流程 block, one open at a time (`id` = basics / entry / exit / sizing / flow), and a condition's bottom sheet (`id` = <entryLong|entryShort|exitLong|exitShort>:<第几条, from 1>).
strategy-editor-section.idRequired: 要带 id：basics / entry / exit / sizing / flow

strategy-editor-picker.desc: 策略编辑卡第二版 (2026-10-08): a condition side's 指标选择器 (`id` = <组>:<第几条>:<left|right>, e.g. entryLong:1:left; the desktop shows it under the row, the phone opens that condition's sheet on that side) and ④ 仓位与时段's 更多 (浮盈加仓、冷却、每个方向次数、当日亏损上限 — its title since the funds work; 开仓手数三选一 fixed/equity_percent/ATR and 回撤停机 live in ④'s body, not here).

help-tip.desc: 说明收进“?” (2026-10-08): one shared "?" popover per explanation (`id` = the explanation's key, e.g. strategy-editor:section-entry; open = the popover shows). The keys on screen are in state.disclosures as help-tip:<key>.
help-tip.idRequired: 要带 id：说明的 key（state.disclosures 里 help-tip:<key>）

strategy-signal-action.desc: 侧栏重设计第三期 (2026-09-25), all per object (`id`): a running card's 执行方式 menu and its 停止 confirmation (`id` = instance id), and an "AI ▾" object menu (`id` = strategy:<id>, instance:<id>, position:<symbol>:<long|short>, order:<clientOrderId>).

strategy-backtest-trades.desc: 规则回测 (2026-09-25): the 逐笔清单 fold of a conversation's rule-backtest card (`id` = card id); the 详情 card's own fold is `strategyBacktest: {trades}`.

strategy-param-help.desc: 说人话 (2026-09-25): a parameter's “?” (`id` = parameter key; on the template parameter page and 详情), a gallery card's 详情 fold (`id` = template id), and the designer's 高级 fold (it replaced 查看完整规则: 常用 blocks show in the open; it opens by itself when the plan uses a 高级 block). `strategy-full-rules` stays accepted as the old name of that fold (older agents and clients send it).

chart-ma-editor.desc: 图表指标就地编辑 (2026-10-02): the chart label popovers — 均线与布林带 on the price pane, the per-pane indicator editor (`id` = pane type kd/macd/rsi/oi), and the ＋副图 chooser. They save through the account preferences (chart.maLines / chart.boll / chart.subPaneList / chart.*Params).

board-columns.desc: 报价总表列设置 (2026-10-02): the board's 列 popover (also mirrored in 设置 → 界面 → 报价总表). Checkbox / 上移 / 下移 save through the account preferences (marketBoard.columns).

price-alerts.desc: 到价提醒 (2026-10-02): the chart toolbar's 提醒 popover (current contract's price form + the alert list). The toolbar button's aria-label carries the active-alert count for observation.

reminder-alert-new.desc: 我的提醒's 新建提醒 (one list since 改版 2026-10-31; open = 到某个价's price form for the shown contract, with 按条件… beside it = strategyEditor {new, reminder}; needs the 提醒 panel's 我的提醒 tab, reminders: {tab: mine}). The alerts go through /api/market/alerts.

playbook-editor.desc: 交易笔记 (was 打法本, 2026-10-25; on the 复盘 page since 改版第一步 2026-10-31): its 新建笔记 form (open = an empty form; needs the 复盘 page, which strategyTab playbooks opens). Saving, editing and deleting a setup go through /api/playbooks.

price-alerts-others.desc: 到价提醒浮层内的“其他合约 N 条”折叠 (needs the price-alerts popover open; a row's contract name switches the chart to that contract, which is the `symbol` command's target).

position-protection.desc: 持仓面板 · 下单顺带保护 (2026-10-02): a position row's 保护 form (`id` = symbol:direction; open = the inline 止损/止盈 form is shown instead of the armed summary).

contract-info.desc: 合约信息卡 (2026-10-02): the contract header's ⓘ popover — 一手/资金/时间/交割四个分块。

flash-calendar.desc: 新闻面板 · 快讯页签 (2026-10-03): 本周重要数据 block's 展开全部 (open = every event of the week, closed = the nearest five). Needs the 快讯 tab mounted (news: {tab: "flash"}).

flash-dropped.desc: 新闻 AI 筛选 (2026-10-07): the 快讯 tab's and the 资讯 tab's folded “AI 筛掉了 N 条” row (open = the dropped items listed under their group names). Needs that tab mounted.

flash-minor.desc: 新闻改版 (2026-10-07 第六批): the folded 次要消息 row of the 快讯 / 资讯 tabs (open = the weak, direction-less events listed; the phone's 调研 page uses flash-minor too) and one merged event's “N 家报道 · 展开” (`id` = the event id from `events[].id`; open = every outlet's report with its own link).

flash-orig.desc: 英文原文折叠 (2026-10-11): a translated headline's 原文 fold — a raw 快讯 row (`id` = the item id), a screened event's headline or one of its reports (`id` = the report id; on the phone the event id).

desk-fundamental.desc: 调研页改版 (2026-10-07 第七批): the 调研 tab's four folds at the bottom — 基本面 (fundamentals, industry data and related products), 宏观 (only the product category's), 相关报道 (the last 7 days, newest first) and 资料来源 (every fact and report with its source, quoted text and date). The phone's 调研 page has the same four.

chart-drawing-tools.desc: 用户画线 (2026-10-02): the first version's 画线 popover. 画线第二版 (2026-10-09) replaced it with the drawing toolbar; the old name stays accepted and means the toolbar (open = shown).

chart-drawing-toolbar.desc: 画线第二版 (2026-10-09), the chart's drawing toolbar and what hangs off it (all K 线 and 分时): chart-drawing-toolbar (open = the toolbar floats over the chart's left edge; it is hidden by default and shows by itself while a tool is armed, owner 2026-10-14; closed = hidden and back to the crosshair); chart-drawing-group (`id` = lines | levels | fib | shapes | notes | measure; open = the toolbar shows with that group's tool list); chart-drawing-tool (`id` = a tool kind, e.g. trendline; open = armed and the toolbar shows — the next chart clicks place it — closed = back to the crosshair, the toolbar hides); the switches chart-drawing-magnet (磁吸: clicks snap to the bar's open/high/low/close), chart-drawing-lock-all (全部锁定) and chart-drawings-hidden (全部隐藏), saved in preferences chart.drawingMagnet / drawingsLocked / drawingsHidden; chart-drawing-clear (open = the 全部删除 second confirmation shows; deleting is DELETE /api/market/drawings?symbol=…); chart-drawing-style (`id` = drawing id; open = that drawing selected with its floating style bar); chart-drawing-settings (`id` = drawing id; open = its 精确设置 dialog); chart-context-menu (`id` = main | drawing:<drawing id> | pane:<kd|macd|rsi|oi>, optionally with a submenu after "/": main/draw, main/period, main/indicator, main/add-pane, drawing:<id>/style, pane:<type>/swap, pane:<type>/add-pane; open = that right-click menu shows over its area). Drawing changes themselves go through /api/market/drawings; the snapshot's state.chartDrawings carries the toolbar and selection.

chart-drawing-group.idRequired: 要带 id：lines / levels / fib / shapes / notes / measure

chart-drawing-tool.idRequired: 要带 id：工具名，如 trendline、hline、fib（state.chartDrawings.tool 是当前工具）

chart-context-menu.idRequired: 要带 id：main / drawing:<线 id> / pane:<kd|macd|rsi|oi>，可加 /draw 等子菜单

chart-periods-more.desc: 周期收起 (2026-10-03): the period row's 更多 popover (3分 / 30分 / 1小时 / 周线). Available only while the bar is too narrow for the full row; picking one is still the `duration` command.

order-depth.desc: 下单面板 · 五档 (2026-10-03): the order panel's five-level fold above the ticket (open by default, remembered on the machine; folded it keeps 买一 / 卖一 on the title line).

ticket-protection.desc: 手机版下单页 (2026-10-04): the ticket's folded 止损 / 止盈 row (open = the two price fields show).

brief-subscriptions.desc: AI 简报订阅 (2026-10-05): 设置 → 通知's 订阅品种 block (open = shown under 简讯提醒; needs settingsPage notify) and its 添加品种 picker (also on the phone's mobilePage briefs). The list itself saves through PUT /api/app/brief-subscriptions.

push-devices.desc: 锁屏提醒 (2026-10-06): 设置 → 通知 → 锁屏提醒's 已开的设备 list (open = each device with 移除 and 发一条试试; needs settingsPage notify). Removing / testing go through /api/app/push.

routine-delete.desc: 我的流程 (2026-10-06): 设置 → 记忆 → 我的流程's per-routine 删 confirmation (`id` = routine id; open = 确认删除 / 取消 shown; the delete itself is DELETE /api/routines/{routine_id}).

plan-quota.desc: 设置 → 账户 (2026-10-08): the 档位 row's fold (open = the tier's 每日 token / 每日语音 with today's use) and the 实盘 switch. No futures company is connected, so the switch stays off: `open: true` is rejected with LIVE_TRADING_UNAVAILABLE (snapshot state.liveTrading); `open: false` is a no-op.

mobile-subpanes.desc: 手机看盘 (2026-10-09): the single chart's 副图设置 sheet (also `mobileMarket: {subPanes}`) and its 均线 / 布林 / SAR parameter fold, the 报价 list's 列 sheet, and one 多图 cell's contract / period sheet (`id` = the cell's index 0–5).

mobile-execution-stop.desc: 手机策略页 (2026-11-01): the head's 停止 menu (open = 只停新开仓 and 急停… show; 急停 opens dialog emergency-stop). Hidden once execution is stopped.

mobile-chart-cell.idRequired: 要带 id：多图格子序号 0–5

mobile-drawing-style-row.desc: 手机画线 (2026-10-09): the selected line's bar under the single chart unfolds one style row at a time (`id` = color | width | dash; open = that row shows). Only while a line is selected (chart-drawing-style).

debate-sheets.desc: 多 AI 研讨 (2026-10-11): the result page's folds — 五份底稿 (the phone's 底稿与来源), 资料来源, 研讨战绩, 研讨记录 and 裁判怎么取舍 (folded on both layouts since 2026-10-24). Need the 辩论 page open (researchDebate {open}).

debate-analyst-technical.desc: 分析师 (2026-10-24): one written analyst report's card (open = its reasoning, key points and the pages it found on the web; closed = its conclusion). Only a finished report folds; needs the 辩论 page open.

guest.desc: What a visitor's window may be told to change (guest.py checks the values; the client refuses the rest too). The pages, dialogs, disclosures and tabs a visitor may open carry "guest": true above. Not here on purpose: researchDebate (a visitor reads the desk's facts but may not start or open a debate) and reminderCenter / mobilePage reminders (reminders are a member's own record).
